source_audit_lineage.prior_audit: R6 PRE_ORBDATA S1-PRE END-TO-END SHELLSET CONSUMER CONTRACT AUDIT
source_audit_lineage.legacy_finding: OrbData derives a residual from sigZZB, clamps it using delta_rho_limit, serializes it as chemical_delta_rho, and Shells consumes it as a lithosphere-wide density anomaly. The residual arithmetic is deterministic; ARCANA had not authorized interpreting it as chemical/compositional geology.

chemical_density_policy.meaning: No independently governed chemical/compositional density anomaly is presently materialized for this runtime state.
chemical_density_policy.scope_limitation: This is the minimum ShellSet runtime representation only. It does not assert globally zero compositional density variation in ARCANA geology.

prohibited_interpretations: Do not infer chemical composition from an isostatic residual.
Do not interpret runtime zero as globally zero compositional density variation.
Do not use delta_rho_limit to authorize a physical chemical-density value.
Do not cancel a nonzero pressure residual by fabricating chemical structure.
Do not reconstruct a future governed compositional-density field retrospectively from ShellSet residuals.

squeez_residual_classification.policy: Calculate and retain residual mechanical state from governed geometry, thermal profile, materials, rhoAst, rhoH2O, and chemical_delta_rho=0. Allow nonzero residuals to propagate as mechanical consequences.

delta_rho_limit_policy.arcana_mode: Do not derive chemical_delta_rho from sigZZB and do not clamp such a derived value. Preserve the governed zero compatibility component and report mechanical residuals without silently cancelling them.
delta_rho_limit_policy.stock_non_arcana_mode: Legacy behavior remains outside this decision scope and must remain unchanged by an ARCANA-only implementation.

thermal_clipping.source_validation: The closed ARCANA thermal-column implementation rejects profiles reaching the numerical ceiling. Continental profiles are checked at Moho/LAB and for the governed internal-temperature constraint; ocean/ridge endpoints are checked and the Hermite validator checks extrema against endpoint bounds.
thermal_clipping.arcana_evaluation: Evaluate the governed polynomial directly; do not apply legacy MIN(temLim,T) clipping.
thermal_clipping.invalid_profile_policy: FAIL_CLOSED if a governed ARCANA profile violates its authorized thermal validity envelope.

future_refinement_rule.replacement_requires: A separately governed physical density/composition field with its own provenance and historical resolution.

S1A_consequences: Read and validate the complete ARCANA_R6_PRE_ORBDATA_RUNTIME_V1 package and bind records by node identity.
Preserve governed heat flow, geometry, owner-specific material state, and transient polynomial profiles.
Set the legacy chemical_delta_rho compatibility output to exactly 0.0 and label it NUMERICAL_RUNTIME_REFERENCE_COMPONENT, not canonical geology.
Retain Squeez sigZZB/tauZZ only as derived mechanical state; do not use them to generate or clamp chemical_delta_rho.
Bypass delta_rho_limit compensation, GDH1, qLim mutation, and legacy steady-geotherm/cooling-curvature fitting in explicit complete ARCANA mode.
Evaluate governed polynomial temperatures directly; fail closed on invalid profiles instead of applying temLim clipping.
S1B_consequences: Independently read and validate the same immutable canonical runtime package, keyed by unchanged FEG node_id.
Keep chemical density contribution at 0.0 in explicit ARCANA mode.
Construct mechanics state from the governed thermal profile and owner-bound material state.
Allow derived stress/isostatic consequences to propagate without converting them to chemical composition.
Bypass legacy profile reconstruction in ARCANA mode and preserve the stock path outside explicit ARCANA mode.
